message:
The other day, we had a little scare when the power went out unexpectedly. In our scramble to find candles and flashlights, we ended up tripping over a stack of board games we’d piled up for a family night that never happened. 🤦‍♀️

It was a comical reminder of how unprepared we really were for even a short outage! We realized we didn’t even have a proper go-bag ready—just a haphazard collection of mismatched socks and old snacks. 

So, we took a moment to laugh and then actually started making a plan. Sometimes, it’s those funny moments that nudge us into action. What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared without losing your sense of humor?
